description: synthetic en rules: message/suggestion formatting, \N references (skip, min=0, phrases), <match> in suggestions, outMsg suggestions, short/url/type, markers incl. sentence edges, comma rule, surrogate/whitespace sentences (11 rules x 63 sentences)

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en">
<phrases><phrase id="P1"><token>a</token><token>b</token></phrase><phrase id="P2"><token>b</token><or><token>c</token><token>x</token></or></phrase></phrases>
<category id="CAT" name="Category">
<rule id="R0" name="Rule 0"><pattern><token skip="-1">a</token><token><match no="1"/></token></pattern><message>dup <suggestion>\1</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R1" name="Rule 1"><pattern><token regexp="yes" skip="-1">a|b</token><token><match no="1"/></token></pattern><message>dup <suggestion>\1 \2</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R2" name="Rule 2"><pattern><token regexp="yes">(a|b)</token><token><match no="1" regexp_match="(.*)" regexp_replace="$1"/></token></pattern><message>dup \1</message></rule>
<rule id="R3" name="Rule 3"><pattern><phraseref idref="P1"/><token>c</token></pattern><message><suggestion>\1 \2</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R4" name="Rule 4"><pattern><token>c</token><phraseref idref="P1"/></pattern><message><suggestion>\1 \2 \3</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R5" name="Rule 5"><pattern><phraseref idref="P1"/><token>c</token></pattern><message><suggestion><match no="1"/> <match no="2"/></suggestion> \3</message></rule>
<rule id="R6" name="Rule 6"><pattern><marker><phraseref idref="P1"/></marker><token>c</token></pattern><message><suggestion>\1</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R7" name="Rule 7"><pattern><phraseref idref="P2"/><token>a</token></pattern><message><suggestion>\1 \2</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R8" name="Rule 8"><pattern><phraseref idref="P1"/><phraseref idref="P2"/></pattern><message><suggestion>\1 \2 \3</suggestion></message></rule>
<rule id="R9" name="Rule 9"><pattern><token>a</token><token>b</token></pattern><message></message></rule>
<rule id="R10" name="Rule 10"><pattern><token>a</token><token>b</token></pattern></rule>
</category>
</rules>
